source_observations.notes: Reduces [[Mana Drain|mana drain]] by up to 20%. It has 200 [[charges]]. Considered rare and valuable in [[Rookgaard]]. Very useful when fighting monsters that drain mana, as it is almost surely to make up for its cost. Some monsters that can deal a lot of mana drain damage are: all kinds of [[Bonelord]]s, [[Demon]]s, [[Dwarf Geomancer]]s, [[Hand of Cursed Fate|Hands of Cursed Fate]], [[Spectre]]s, [[Dipthrah]], [[Priestess]]es, [[Warlock]]s.
